Marvelous Designer is Coming to GDC 2025!

Join us from March 19–21 at Booth #S1362 in the Moscone Center, San Francisco for an exclusive look at what's next.

🔹 Discover Marvelous Designer's Latest Innovations – See how our newest improvements can optimize your workflow.

🎮 Interactive Game Station – Get hands-on with Marvelous Designer and experience our tools like never before!

🎁 Exclusive Giveaways – Visit our booth for a chance to win Marvelous Designer goodies!

👥 Meet Our Team – Stop by for live demos, industry insights, and exciting conversations about the future of CG and game development.

  


Don't miss this chance to connect with us—we can't wait to see you at GDC 2025!

  


**📍 Booth #S1362 | March 19–21 | Moscone Center, SF**

  


See you there! 🚀

title: How do I hang pants, jeans, or leggings horizontally on a hanger with clips in Marvelous Designer?
content:
I'm trying to set up pants (trousers), jeans, leggings, or similar garments horizontally using a hanger with clips—similar to the example shown in this photo.

I haven't been able to find tutorials specifically covering this type of arrangement in MD. Most tutorials only show tops, such as T-shirts or hoodies, placed vertically on standard hangers, which seems straightforward.

My issue is specifically with how to realistically clip and stretch pants horizontally using the clips in this hanger setup.

Does anyone have experience or tips on how to achieve this properly in Marvelous Designer? Thanks!

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/e9dda44a76b4471c93c180a54c14c007/images/5640c4e3345b4a36b1ca86ab577869b9time__1732539911__202501-1000261-961-flat-fv-1.webp)
